native_lifecycle.epochs: StructureEpoch, MatrixEpoch, and PreconditionerEpoch are tracked independently
native_lifecycle.case_a: unchanged matrix updates persistent RHS and warm-start x, then enters direct FlexGMRES without matrix or setup work
native_lifecycle.case_b1: current A is refreshed and BoomerAMG is rebuilt when age, Krylov/nonlinear degradation, or recovery policy requires it
native_lifecycle.case_b2: current A is refreshed, supported FlexGMRES setup runs, the bounded-age older AMG hierarchy is retained by the setup wrapper, and FlexGMRES applies it to the current operator
native_lifecycle.recovery: failed B2 convergence clears stale HYPRE state, refreshes setup on current A, restores x, and retries with cooldown

notes: Production keeps the linear operator current; operator lagging is disabled while preconditioner lagging is adaptive.
The run exercised both B2 reuse and B1 fresh-AMG decisions, plus three controlled recovery rebuilds.
Case-A zero-setup assertions remain active in the native lifecycle implementation; this mixed production run had no unchanged-matrix Case-A solves.
FlexGMRES remains the production Krylov method because the CSR symmetry defect is nonzero.
One reused-preconditioner solve intentionally reached the configured linear iteration limit and recovered on the current operator; the overall run exited 0.
